## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds InSitu only and all 5 similar cases agree [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Invasive 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {InSitu}, α 0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / OOD pct 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; fits in situ disease [F2] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score here; concept model leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; negligible concept-model contribution · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score, but spot check 3/20; disregard · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit drop, CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (0.002; −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable: mitoses 0/20, normal lobules 0/20, necrosis 3/20.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated JPEG-degraded image (severity 3); reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Region 1 alone scores 67% invasive on the per-region probe; the image-level call may dilute it.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 6, 8** Confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts, with no stromal breach.
2. **1** Highest per-region invasive probability (67%); look for stromal invasion.
3. **8, 9** Verify tumor at inferior edge; simulated frozen-section margin call is not covered by validation.
